name: find_doctor_by_specialty
description: Finds an available doctor's name and room number based on their medical specialty. Use this to find the right doctor for a patient's symptoms.

specialty.description: The medical specialty to search for (e.g., 'Gastroenterology', 'Cardiology', 'General Practice').

name: guide_patient_to_room
description: Dispatches a mobile robot to guide a patient to a specific room number.

room_number.description: The destination room number, for example '001' or '102'.

name: speak
description: Allows the robot to say a message out loud to the user.

message.description: The message for the robot to speak.
